description: Refused the sale, and looked at the quoting man as at a burglar.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Gave the count, every third man, and kept Thursday next as the answer she had already given.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Named the inns, and named Thursday the sixteenth for the next king.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Took the shout of Remuneration, and stayed Sweet Master Shakespeare.
name: Will Kemp

description: Said the speeches were the company's, and went on as Navarre.
name: William Shakespeare
